## Description and Rationale

I am a recent graduate participating independently, with a strong interest in data science, machine learning, and real-world optimisation. I decided to join the PRC Data Challenge because it offers an opportunity to apply open data and reproducible methods to a practical aviation problem: predicting aircraft taxi-out times. Through the challenge, I hope to develop a useful and well-documented solution, deepen my understanding of aviation operations, and openly share my code and findings with the wider community.
